headline.text: All L3 cleaning verification passed ATP — one Truffle Line weight deviation caught and corrected on shift, Sweco screen installation flagged for *assembly review* despite clean result.

summary: L3 Truffle Line completed weekend cleaning with all ATP passes. One weight/count deviation during production was caught by QA and corrected same shift. QA flagged Sweco screen installation for review despite successful ATP — potential assembly gap.

quality.title: Truffle Line weight/count deviation corrected on shift
quality.summary: Individual piece weights increased from spec, dropping box count to 236–238 pieces; operator adjusted and stabilized weights at 14.1–14.7 g, restoring count to 253–255 pieces.
quality.status: Resolved on shift — line continues within spec, no outstanding deviations.

sanitation.title: Sweco screen installation flagged for review after ATP pass
sanitation.summary: Level 2 final cleaning passed visual inspection and ATP verification; QA suggested reviewing Sweco screen installation despite clean result — potential assembly or fit concern.
sanitation.status: Open — ATP passed, installation review recommended for Monday.

opportunities.text: Consider adding assembly verification step to Sweco screen cleaning checklist — today's Level 2 clean passed ATP but QA flagged installation for review, suggesting fit or assembly may not be visually obvious during routine checks.
